profile.name: Yugesh Coder
profile.tagline: Data engineer building scalable platforms, AI-driven tools, and modern web apps.
profile.bio: I'm Yugesh, an AI & Data Science student who loves turning ideas into working tech. I'm into AI, IoT, embedded systems, and software development, and I've built a self-driven project portfolio spanning AgriTech, HealthTech, and accessibility think an agriculture IoT/drone system, a medicine verification platform, an AI stock prediction tool, an accessibility app for blind users, and a few AI assistants along the way. I like calling myself a deep-tech product builder. I'm not just interested in the AI/ML side, I like taking things end-to-end, from data to a working, usable product. Long term, I'm chasing a future as a founding engineer at a high-growth deep-tech startup, building things that actually move the needle.
